senses.zh_definition: 安妮；常见女性名字，在马来语句子中作为人名专有名词使用。
senses.en_definition: A personal given name, commonly feminine, used as a proper noun in Malay texts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi yang lazimnya digunakan oleh perempuan dan berfungsi sebagai kata nama khas dalam ayat bahasa Melayu.

etymology.historical_story: Anne is a French form of Anna, belonging to the name family ultimately connected with Hebrew Hannah and the idea of favour or grace. Its history crosses languages rather than Malay affix patterns. In a Malay sentence, Anne identifies a person; its ancestral meaning does not become an ordinary Malay definition. [Anne](https://www.behindthename.com/name/anne-1), [Hannah](https://www.behindthename.com/name/hannah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语读音 /æn/ 与名字 Anne 绑定：末尾 e 不另读一拍；看到 Anne，先认人名“安妮”。
